details: Source review 6894bbcd: control.rs interrupt_exact uses state.lock(), while start_thread/submit use try_lock. ScopedAuthority calls bounded interrupt under its gate; busy mutex can delay stop/gate without deadline. read_turn_status, interrupt request and reconciliation also start separate timeout budgets; require one explicit operation budget. Existing issue, uncovered during V055BOUND, no live interrupt repeated. Terra owns fix before public HumanStop path.
